title: Menyhal osztrigával (Lamprey with Oysters)
description: Prepared with oysters, pike, and breadcrumbs.
steps: After opening the lampreys, salt them and lard them so they maintain their shape and cook them well seasoned
Take oysters from their shells, cook them through, add minced pike liver and braise both together in butter
Brown some breadcrumbs in butter, pour 2 tablespoons pea broth over it, add lemon juice and peel and 2 tablespoons sour cream
Arrange lampreys on a plate, pour the sauce over, bring once to a boil and serve

title: Metélt fánkocsaka (Fried Noodle Cakes)
description: A cake made with egg yolks, cream, and ground almonds.
steps: Make common noodle dough from flour, egg and egg yolks

Fry until golden yellow in fat

title: Mogyoró-fagylalt (Hazelnut Ice Cream)
description: Prepared with cream, hazelnuts, and sugar.
steps: Soak the large Italian hazelnuts similarly to almonds
Clean in cold water
Grind to a fine paste
Boil 7 deciliters of good cream
Place the ground hazelnuts in a soup pot
Pour the cream warm over it
Let stand for one hour, stirring frequently
Add 21 dekagrams ground sugar
Stir frequently
When the sugar has melted and the mixture has cooled, strain through cloth
Pour into the container and treat as with the other ice creams

title: Mogyoró-parfait (Hazelnut Cream Frozen Dessert)
description: Prepared with hazelnut, cream, and egg yolks.
steps: Finely grind 21 dekagrams hazelnut kernels in milk, then pour into a pot.
Pour in {{source-2}} and stir until boiling, then allow to cool.
Thoroughly blend 16 egg yolks with 42 dekagrams powdered sugar.
Press the cream through a clean kitchen cloth and pour into the eggs.
Stir over gentle charcoal fire with a whisk until nearly boiling, but it must not boil.
After straining, continue stirring until cooled, then pour into the freezer.

title: Mogyoró-torta (Hazelnut Cake)
description: A cake made with cake, hazelnuts, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: three identical cake leaves and their hoops
ingredients.sourceText: three identical cake leaves and their hoops

ingredients.name: preserved apricot or a beautiful apple for decoration
ingredients.sourceText: preserved apricot or a beautiful apple for decoration

steps: Shell the hazelnuts, rub well in cloth, and grind them.
Similarly grind twenty-eight dekagrams of sugar and sift it.
Place the sugar in a basin with eleven egg yolks and beat until white and well foamy.
Add the ground hazelnuts and beat well.
Fold in the stiff foam of five egg whites.
Coat three identical cake leaves and their hoops with butter.
Fill with the mixture and bake over gentle heat.
To test if well baked, after half an hour insert a large needle into the center of the cake; if the needle remains clean, turn the cake out onto a sieve and cool it.
When completely cooled, coat the first layer with apricot syrup, place the second on top, fill it with preserved raspberries, and cover with the third layer.
Cover the entire cake evenly with lemon icing.
Cut long slices from quince paste or candied quince.
Slice green almond lengthwise and arrange a star in the center of the cake.
Place a whole preserved apricot or a beautiful apple in the center of the almond star.
Arrange the quince paste strips at finger-width intervals around the edge of the cake, placing the green almond leaves beside them as if serving as a stem.
Place the cake on a plate covered with a neatly folded napkin.

title: Mornay-mártás (Mornay Sauce - Warm Fish Sauce)
description: A sauce made with parmesan cheese, butter, and flour.
steps: Make a roux from butter and flour
Dilute with milk to obtain a fairly thick béchamel
Simmer the béchamel while stirring
Add one weak tablespoon of grated Parmesan cheese per three tablespoons of béchamel
Slowly mix in 20-25 dgr of butter while continuously stirring with a whisk to obtain a smooth sauce
After adding the cheese, do not stir over heat, only keep it warm
Season with pepper and salt
Use with pre-cooked fish, meat, or eggs by pouring the thick sauce over them, sprinkling with Parmesan cheese and baking in a hot oven for one to two minutes

title: Multiply-Baked Cake (Többször sült lepény)
description: Prepared with cherries, powdered sugar, and cream.
steps: Make a crumbly dough from 28 dekagrams butter and roll it as thin as a knife blade
Place it on a flat prepared pan and prick it with a fork to prevent it from puffing up during baking
Bake in the oven until golden
Cover with enough fresh sour cherries to cover the bottom and sprinkle well with powdered sugar and bake through
When the dough is well baked, prepare 7 decilitres of cream with 14 dekagrams sugar, a little vanilla and ten egg yolks, whisk together in a pan over gentle heat until it begins to thicken
Pour half of this mixture carefully over the fruit, quickly place in the oven until set, then pour the remaining half over and place in the oven again
When set, remove, cool, cut into large cubes and serve

This cake can be made the same way with apricots or raspberries - peel the apricots, cut them in half, cover the dough with them, sprinkle well with sugar and bake; when baked, pour the same sauce over it as before; note that the inner edge of the pan should be well coated with egg white and the dough pressed together firmly at the edges or it will fall off; for the sauce use a coffee spoon of sifted vanilla

title: Muskatály-szőlő-kocsonya kőmagú gyümölccsel (Muscatel Grape Jelly with Stone Fruits)
description: Prepared with grape, juice, and isinglass.

ingredients.name: 2 ripe, peeled apricots cut into 4 pieces
ingredients.sourceText: 2 ripe, peeled apricots cut into 4 pieces

steps: Embed a ring-shaped mold with a center opening in ice
Remove ripe flavorful grapes from their stems and press the juice through cloth
For 7 deciliters of juice, use 42 dekagrams of sugar
Cook the sugar with a cup of common water until the sugar begins to thread
Pour the juice into the sugar mixture and blend well
Press the juice of 3 lemons and mix with 4.5 dekagrams of dissolved isinglass
Strain through stretched cloth lined with blotting paper
Fill the outer form's empty space to the edges
Leave on ice until firm
In the empty center, carefully arrange 2 beautiful ripe peeled apricots cut into 4 pieces, 4-5 mirabelle plums, and ripe blue grapes dusted with sugar
Fill with remaining jelly and freeze
Turn out onto a plate similar to other jellies

description: Prepared with egg yolks, sour cream, and cheese.

ingredients.name: 1.5 decagrams fresh cheese yeast dissolved in the sour cream
ingredients.sourceText: 1.5 decagrams fresh cheese yeast dissolved in the sour cream

ingredients.name: peel of half a lemon and half an orange, finely chopped
ingredients.sourceText: peel of half a lemon and half an orange, finely chopped

steps: Beat 14 decagrams butter until fluffy and add 8 egg yolks one by one
Well mixed, add 1 spoon broken sugar, 2 deciliters sour cream, fresh cheese yeast, a little salt and 7 deciliters flour
Mix everything well, knead the dough finely and let it rise slightly
When the dough has risen, place on a board well sprinkled with flour and stretch to knife-edge thickness
Finely grind 4 deciliters poppy seeds, mix with 21 decagrams broken sugar, a little cinnamon, and finely chopped peel of half a lemon and half an orange
Sprinkle the dough thickly with this filling, pour 8 spoonfuls of good sour cream over it and fold together
Place in a buttered flat dish and let it rise
Brush with butter, bake and sprinkle generously with sugar before serving

title: Málna- vagy Ribizli-levet Befőzni (Raspberry or Currant Juice Preserve)
description: A fruit preserve made with juice or raspberries or currants, sugar, and water.

ingredients.name: clear juice from raspberries or currants
ingredients.sourceText: 1/2 kilogram clear juice from raspberries or currants

steps: Press the juice of these fruits through cloth, then strain through filter paper.
Cook 1/2 kilogram clear juice with {{source-1}} and 4 decilitres water, clean it well and cook until it threads and throws large bubbles.
Add the juice, cook on a gentle charcoal fire for a good quarter hour and carefully remove the foam.
Test by dropping a few drops on a plate, and if it no longer spreads, the juice is sufficiently cooked.
This juice must not cook any longer as otherwise it would lose flavor and color; then cool it, pour into jars, and put in a cool place.

title: Málna-, Ribizli-, vagy Meggy-levet Készíteni Kocsonyához és Fagylalthoz (Raspberry, Currant, or Cherry Juice for Jelly and Ice Cream)
description: Prepared with raspberries or currants or cherries and sugar.

ingredients.name: broken sugar per 1/2 kilogram juice
ingredients.sourceText: 1/2 kilogram broken sugar per 1/2 kilogram juice

steps: Press the raspberries, currants, or cherries through a clean cloth and strain the juice through filter paper so it is beautifully clear, doing this in a cold place so the juice does not boil.

Measure the juice and take the same amount of broken sugar for each 1/2 kilogram of juice, place the sugar with the juice in a clean white soup bowl and stir with a silver spoon until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Pour the juice into a dry glass bottle, filling only to the neck, then quickly stopper it firmly, cork it, and keep in a cool place.
If preparing the juice from cherries, crush them in a mortar so the seed flavor is also perceptible, press the juice through cloth, strain it and treat it the same way as above.

title: Málna-eczet (Raspberry Vinegar)
description: Prepared with vinegar and raspberries.
steps: Crush 3 dekagrams of fresh good raspberries slightly, and mix them in a bottle with 2 kilograms of well-boiled vinegar.
When the vinegar becomes beautifully red and has a pleasant raspberry smell, carefully pour off the liquid without pressing it, then let it settle.
Filter through grey blotting paper, fill small bottles completely with it, bind them tightly with bladder, and place them in the cellar in sand.

title: Másfél kilogramm erős méz alapú eczet (Vinegar Based on One and a Half Kilograms Strong Honey)
description: Prepared with honey, vinegar, and brandy.
steps: Pour 1.5 kilograms of strong honey and 25 dekagrams of red powdered tartar into a pot filled with water.
Keep the liquid at a boil with slow stirring until the tartar dissolves, then filter through cloth.
Cool this decoction until you can hold your hand in it, then pour it into a vinegar barrel and add 17 liters of good brandy.

Cut 0.5 kilogram of rye bread into small pieces, cover it with 2 liters of strong vinegar, heat it almost to boiling, then pour the mixture into the barrel, shake it well, place the barrel in a warm spot, and after 6-8 weeks carefully draw off the vinegar.

title: Méz-eczet (Honey Vinegar)
description: Prepared with honey and water.
steps: Take sweet water obtained from honey pomace, place it in sour earthenware pots, and set them next to the oven, by which means after 4-6 weeks you will obtain good vinegar.
Alternatively, take 12 kilograms of water with 75 dekagrams of honey (this amount is necessary for twelve liters), place them together on the fire, remove the foam, and add 25 dekagrams of tartar.
Boil the mixture for a time, then strain it through cloth into a barrel and place it in a warm spot so it boils for a few moments.
Draw off the now-ready vinegar, clarify the cloudy part in a pot with bladder, and pour the vinegar together with the clarified part into a small barrel.
Once it has sufficiently soured, draw it off into bottles, which, well-stoppered, will keep for a long time.

title: Napoleon-torta csokoládéval bevonva (Napoleon Cake Coated with Chocolate)
description: A cake made with chocolate, almonds, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: 28 dekagramm chocolate, softened in a warm oven
ingredients.sourceText: 28 dekagramm chocolate, softened in a warm oven

ingredients.name: 28 dekagramm almonds, shelled, broken, and sifted
ingredients.sourceText: 28 dekagramm almonds, shelled, broken, and sifted

ingredients.name: 28 dekagramm sugar, broken with vanilla and sifted
ingredients.sourceText: 28 dekagramm sugar, broken with vanilla and sifted

steps: Soften 28 dekagramm chocolate in a warm oven and blend finely in a bowl with a piece of butter.
Add another piece of butter and blend smoothly, then continue alternating butter additions until 28 dekagramm of butter is fully incorporated.
Slowly add 28 dekagramm of shelled, broken, and sifted almonds, the same amount of sugar broken with vanilla and sifted, and 16 egg yolks.
Stir this mixture foamily for half an hour.
Finally fold in the stiffly beaten egg white foam and 14 dekagramm of cornstarch.
Prepare four equal, low-rimmed cake layers, butter them, dust with flour, fill with the mixture, and bake in a gently heated oven.
Once fully baked, turn out onto a sieve and cool.
Place on parchment paper and spread apricot marmalade to the thickness of a knife blade.
Stack the layers on top of each other and trim neatly.
Coat the entire cake evenly with chocolate glaze and set aside to dry.
Once completely dry, decorate with various preserved fruits.

title: Narancs-hab (Orange Foam)
description: Prepared with oranges, lemons, and egg white.

ingredients.name: 6 large oranges and 8 small oranges, for juice
ingredients.sourceText: 6 large oranges and 8 small oranges, for juice

steps: Rub 42 dekagrams of sugar on 3 oranges, being careful not to rub too deeply lest it become bitter
Squeeze the juice from 6 large and 8 small oranges and mix it with the juice of 4 lemons
Pour over the sugar to dissolve it
If not sweet enough, add a little more sugar
Pour this juice into a deep preserving basin, set on ice, add fresh egg white, and beat with a whip until the entire mass becomes foam
Cool the juice very well on ice beforehand and keep it on ice during beating
If the mixture will not come together, add a little more egg white
Finally, fold in 4.5 dekagrams of previously strained and cooled dissolved isinglass
Pour into a mold, set on ice until frozen
The same method can be used to make foam from any fresh fruit, such as raspberries, currants, or cherries; press the fruit through cloth, dissolve the sugar with it, and proceed in the same manner

title: Narancs-pép (Orange Paste)
description: Prepared with almonds, oranges, and egg yolks.
steps: Grind the almonds, sprinkling lightly with fresh water during grinding to prevent them becoming oily
Rub the sugar on two oranges, then grind it finely
Place the ground almonds and sugar in a bowl
Beat in the whole egg and four egg yolks
Stir in the lemon juice and beat everything for one hour
Finally fold in the stiffly whipped egg whites
Spread the paste on a buttered pastry sheet and bake
When nearly finished baking, whip two tablespoons of raspberry marmalade with seven dekagrams of ground sugar until very frothy
Fold in the stiff egg white meringue of four eggs, a little at a time, ensuring it is not watery
Remove the pastry sheet rim
Shape the meringue into a crown on top of the paste, piling it high with a knife
Make indentations every two finger-widths with a card edge to resemble a braided crown
Sprinkle with ground sugar
Return to the oven
Work very quickly to prevent the paste from collapsing

title: Narancs-torta (Orange Cake)
description: A cake made with oranges, egg yolks, and almonds.

ingredients.name: 2 large or 3 small oranges, zest grated
ingredients.sourceText: 2 large or 3 small oranges, zest grated

ingredients.name: 28 dekagramm swollen and finely broken almonds
ingredients.sourceText: 28 dekagramm swollen and finely broken almonds

steps: Grate the zest of 2 large or 3 small oranges and finely pound it in a mortar with 6 hard-boiled egg yolks.
Beat 5 dekagramm of butter to a foam, then gradually blend in 3 egg yolks one after another.
Add 28 dekagramm of swollen and finely broken almonds, and stir for half an hour.
Add the same amount of sifted sugar and stir for another quarter hour.
Add the orange zest mixed with egg yolks, and mix everything well with 1.5 dekagramm of fine flour.
Divide the mixture into two parts, place in buttered cake layers, spread evenly with a knife, and fill with preserved sour cherries.
Pipe the third part in a ring shape over the top.
Brush the cake with egg white and sprinkle with coarsely broken sugar.
Bake slowly and decorate with icing.

title: Nyúl Sülve (Roast Rabbit)
description: Prepared with rabbit, vinegar, and onion.
steps: After removing the entrails and cleaning the rabbit thoroughly, remove its blue skin and salt it well.
Prepare a marinade from vinegar, water, red onion, lemon juice, and a few peppercorns; boil this together for half an hour.
Place the rabbit in this hot marinade and leave it for one to two days.
Before roasting, lard the back and thighs with lard, then roast slowly, basting frequently with the marinade.
When the rabbit is halfway cooked, pour a few spoonfuls of cream over it.
When fully roasted and placed on the plate, surround it with the thinnest possible lemon slices from which the seeds have been removed.
Strain the sauce and pour it under the rabbit.

title: Nápolyi kifli (Neapolitan Croissants)
description: Prepared with cake, dough, and apricot or raspberry or syrup.
steps: Prepare sponge cake dough and grease a large sheet with butter
Make a border around the edge of the sheet from strong dough to prevent the sponge cake dough from running off
With the help of a large knife, spread the sponge cake dough on the sheet to the thickness of a knife blade and bake it at gentle heat
Once baked, use a small pastry cutter to cut out crescent shapes or croissants, fill them with apricot or raspberry syrup, place another on top, and continue until all are filled
Prepare Spanish thread dough from 3 egg whites, 16 dekagrams sugar, and a small amount of vanilla
Fill a pastry bag with the mixture; the tube must have a very small opening and the lines must be very fine
Press thin lines crosswise into the croissants, with the space between lines only as wide as a knife blade, then add another line
Once all are piped, place in the oven to dry as quickly as possible without browning

Meanwhile, prepare orange preserve from 42 dekagrams fine sugar, with the difference that when the sugar that has been worked for a long time is white and has the consistency of child-paste, add 2 teaspoons of finely ground sugar first rubbed on an orange and 4 teaspoons of orange juice
Once the croissants are dried, dip the upper side entirely in the preserve and place them upper-side down on paper until they harden, then pile them high on a plate
The surest test that the sugar is properly made into preserve is if during cooking it forms large bubbles, and during the working you see that what flows off the spoon is white and thick

title: Orange Aspic (Narancs-kocsonya)
description: Prepared with orange, oranges, and lemons.
steps: Gently rub 42 dekagrams sugar on 2 orange peels; do not rub hard or it will become bitter.
Scrape off the rubbed sugar with a knife and place in a soup bowl.
Squeeze juice from 10 oranges and 2 lemons and dissolve the sugar in this juice.
May add 4 additional deciliters of water if desired.
Once sugar is completely dissolved, add 4.5 dekagrams isinglass and mix well with the juice.
Strain through a large, double-stretched cloth as with other aspics, pour into molds, and place on ice.

If decorating this aspic, pour only 2 centimeters height into mold and freeze on ice; then arrange candied orange segments in star pattern around mold, add another 2 centimeters of mixture and freeze; once firm, pour remaining mixture on top and keep on ice until use.

title: Ostya (Wafer)
description: Prepared with almonds, cream, and sugar.
steps: Pound 7 dekagramm swollen almonds very fine; similarly pound 10 dekagramm sugar with vanilla
Place in a pot with a teaspoon of flour and 2 whole eggs
Mix the dough well
Slowly pour in 2 deciliters cream
Once well mixed, bake the wafers over a flame fire on a wafer iron
The small roller on which you quickly rotate them should not be thicker than a little finger

title: Osztrigával Töltött Sült Kappan (Roasted Capon Stuffed with Oysters)
description: Prepared with oysters, capon, and breadcrumbs.
steps: Melt four decagrams of butter and mix with a handful of breadcrumbs, twenty shucked oysters, salt, and mace
Stuff the capon with this mixture
Roast the capon nicely
Prepare a golden roux from a little butter and flour
Add a spoonful of good broth, the capon drippings, twenty oysters, and lemon juice
Simmer well
Pour the sauce underneath when serving

title: Paczal (Offal Hash)
description: Prepared with tripe, vegetables, and sour cream.
steps: Rinse the carefully selected paczal thoroughly with hot water and broth
Slice it thinly on a board
Place in hot water with salt and cook well
Add vegetables to it
Prepare a binding from half liter good sour cream and a few tablespoons fine flour
Chop a few hard-boiled eggs into cubes and mix in
Carefully add the binding, sprinkle in fresh parsley leaves
Bring to a boil and serve
Alternatively, instead of the sour cream binding, prepare a fatty breadcrumb roux and use that to bind it, season with a little lemon juice and serve

title: Pain Eperből (Strawberry Pain)
description: Prepared with strawberries, isinglass or gelatin, and lemons.

ingredients.name: 56 decagrams fine garden or wild strawberries, sifted
ingredients.sourceText: 56 decagrams fine garden or wild strawberries, sifted

steps: Chill a smooth cylindrical mold on ice
Add a few spoonfuls of well-strained and slightly thickened wine gelée and rotate the mold on all sides until covered with a layer of gelée
Place the mold back on ice and decorate with raw or preserved fruit as desired
In a porcelain bowl, combine the strained strawberry purée with the sugar syrup (made by cooking sugar in 2 deciliters of water to a not very thick syrup), the isinglass or gelatin, and lemon juice
Stir this mixture on ice in the porcelain bowl until it becomes thick
Fill the prepared mold with this mass and freeze
A test is necessary here as well; if the gelée becomes too stiff, add a little water

title: Palacsinta gyermekpéppel (Pancakes with Baby Cereal)
description: Prepared with ground almonds, egg yolks, and sour cream.

ingredients.name: one whole egg and four egg yolks
ingredients.sourceText: one whole egg and four egg yolks

steps: Cook twelve to fifteen pancakes
In a saucepan, mix {{source-1}} smoothly with milk and place over heat, stirring until it begins to thicken, then cook a little longer
Pour onto a plate and cool
Beat seven dekagrams butter until foamy, add the cereal, then beat in one whole egg and four egg yolks one at a time
Add a handful of swollen finely ground almonds, seven dekagrams finely ground sugar and a little vanilla, and stir for another quarter hour
Spread the mixture on the pancakes, roll them up and cut into square pieces
Arrange the cut pancakes in even rows in a buttered saucepan
Mix three egg yolks with two deciliters sour cream, a little sugar and vanilla, pour over and steam for half an hour

title: Palacsinta habart mandolás tésztával (Pancake with Beaten Almond Paste)
description: Prepared with almond, egg yolks, and cream.
steps: Make or bake eighteen very thin pancakes, crush fourteen dekagrams softened almond finely, chop lemon zest finely, place this and fourteen dekagrams sugar in a bowl, beat one whole egg and three egg yolks on it one after another and beat until foamy
Spread the almond paste on the pancakes and fold them, cut into pieces of finger thickness

Grease a pan or porcelain plate with butter, stand the pancakes upright around the sides in two or three rows, put four egg yolks, a little crushed sugar and two decilitres good cream in a pot, mix well and pour over
Place in the oven and brown on top
The same way the pancakes can be filled with raisins and small grapes, or with preserved sour cherry, crushed nuts, cinnamon, sugar

title: Palacsinta porhanyós tésztában (Pancakes in Crumbly Dough)
description: Prepared with dough, sour cream, and ground almonds.
steps: Cook sixteen to twenty pancakes and cut them into strips

Bring four deciliters sour cream to a boil, add nine dekagrams finely ground almonds, a piece of sugar, a little vanilla and the cut pancakes and cook through well, but the strips should remain visible and not become a paste
Cool, beat four egg yolks over it and mix well, noting that it should be thicker than common cereal
Roll out crumbly dough as thin as lasagna dough, place in a saucepan or mold without wrinkles, add the pancake mixture, cover with dough and bake
When done, turn out onto a platter

title: Palacsinta rizszsel (Pancakes with Rice)
description: Prepared with rice, ground almonds, and lemon.

ingredients.name: two whole eggs and four egg yolks
ingredients.sourceText: two whole eggs and four egg yolks

steps: Cook ten dekagrams washed rice in seven deciliters milk until soft enough, adding ten dekagrams finely ground almonds during cooking
Thicken and cool
Beat seven dekagrams butter until foamy, add the rice, then beat in two whole eggs and four egg yolks one at a time and stir for half an hour
Add enough sugar for sweetness

Divide the mixture into three parts: the first remains as is but add zest of lemon-sugar rubbed orange; to the second add two tablets of fine chocolate; to the third add three tablespoons of apricot syrup mixed smooth and stir well for color
Fold stiffly beaten egg whites from four egg whites into each part in three portions
Butter a round mold, cook the pancakes as thin as possible and line the entire mold with them

Layer the orange-flavored portion, cover with pancakes, add the chocolate portion, cover with pancakes, and finish with the final portion of cereal, cover with pancakes and bake in the oven until nicely browned
When done, turn out onto a platter and serve at once

title: Palacsinta szilvával töltve (Pancakes Filled with Plums)
description: Prepared with plums, sour cream, and milk.
steps: From four decilitres of milk and three eggs, make thin pancakes
Fill them very thinly with preserved plums
Fold them together and cut them in half in the middle, as well as trim the uneven two ends
Place a little butter and good sour cream on a plate, then arrange the filled pancakes in a star shape on the bottom of the plate
Again add sour cream and butter, then pancake, and so on, until everything is arranged
Finally add a little more sour cream and small pieces of butter on top
Let it come to a boil slightly and serve sprinkled with sugar on the table

title: Palacsinta-tekercs (Rolled Pancakes with Veal)
description: Prepared with veal, onion, and goose fat or butter.
steps: Chop the stewed veal finely with half red onion and a little fresh parsley.
In clarified goose fat or butter, brown a spoonful of flour, add the chopped veal, pour half a serving spoon of good broth over it, and cook down until thick.
Meanwhile, make fine pancakes and cut them into squares.
Spread filling on each pancake, roll them up, dip in beaten egg and fine breadcrumbs, then fry in fat.
When serving, stack them in a cone shape.

title: Palacsinta-tekercs vaddal (Rolled Pancakes with Game)
description: Prepared with venison or rabbit, bread, and lemon juice.
steps: Make fine uniform pancakes.
Chop leftover roasted venison or rabbit finely, along with a little lemon zest.
Remove the crust from a bread roll, soak half of it in milk, squeeze it well, and chop it finely with the game meat.
Place this mixture in a bowl, add half lemon juice and one or two egg yolks depending on the amount of filling.
The filling should be spreadable but not thin.
Spread the filling smoothly on each pancake with a knife, but not quite to the edges.
Brush the ends with egg yolk, roll up, and trim the ends.
Dip in beaten egg, roll in breadcrumbs, and fry in fat.
When cooked, place on a plate and top with fried green parsley.

steps: Crush 14 dekagrams soaked almonds and 14 dekagrams hazelnuts to a fine paste

title: Paprikás borjúsült egy darabban (Paprika Veal Roast in One Piece)
description: Prepared with veal, paprika, and fat.

ingredients.name: tender veal from the hind part
ingredients.sourceText: tender veal from the hind part

steps: Put fat in a pot and fry abundant onion and a few black and clove peppercorns until golden, add one teaspoon of paprika
Beat the veal well but not so it falls apart, salt it and coat in flour, place immediately in the hot fat
This roast should cook quickly, three-quarters of an hour is enough
To serve, pour a little broth underneath, and when sliced onto a plate, strain the sauce through a sieve onto it while hot
The sauce should be a nice red color; the veal remains white from the quick cooking, looks very nice and is tender and fine

title: Paprikás csirke (Hungarian Paprika Chicken)
description: Prepared with paprika, chickens, and onion.
steps: Singe the chickens, cut them up, wash clean, cut into uniform pieces and lightly salt
Finely chop an onion and braise it in butter in a copper pan until golden
Add the chicken pieces and half a tablespoon of paprika
Cover and let simmer, shaking frequently until tender
Dust with a little flour, add a little chicken broth and a few spoonfuls of sour cream
Let simmer slowly, skim the foam carefully and serve with fresh parsley

title: Paprikás csirke, valódi magyar (True Hungarian Paprika Chicken)
description: Prepared with paprika, chickens, and bacon.
steps: Singe the chickens and cut into regular pieces (from one chicken: 2 thighs, 2 second thighs, 1 bishop's cut, 1 beggar's purse, the head and neck, 2 wings with giblets and liver, and 4-5 breast pieces if the chicken is larger; small chicks should be quartered)
Place the cut meat in a bowl filled with water
Chop fresh bacon into small cubes (2-3 decagrams per chicken) and render it in a pot until breadcrumb-colored
For each chicken, add 1 teaspoon of rose paprika to the hot fat where the rendered bacon remains, stir quickly and add the chicken with plenty of water
Cover and braise, if the liquid reduces completely it can be increased with fat-free broth
Season with salt at mid-cooking, and when the chicken is sufficiently tender, add 1-2 tablespoons of sweet unsoured sour cream per medium chicken
Once it comes to a boil, add a good pinch of finely chopped green parsley for each chicken, let it come to a boil again, serve and garnish with fine whipped dumplings

Season with salt at mid-cooking, and when the chicken is sufficiently tender, add 1-2 tablespoons of sweet unsoured sour cream per medium chicken
Once it comes to a boil, add a good pinch of finely chopped green parsley for each chicken, let it come to a boil again, serve and garnish with fine whipped dumplings

title: Pergelt-torta (Caramelized Almond Cake)
description: A cake made with almonds, almond oil, and lemon.
steps: Finely grind the sugar and slice the softened almonds and dry in a lukewarm oven
Place the ground sugar in a brass preserving pan over strong charcoal fire, stirring continuously with a cooking spoon
Break up the small pellets that form, until the sugar completely melts and begins to turn yellowish
Quickly add the dried almonds and stir until both are well mixed and have taken on a light breadcrumb color
Quickly fill the caramelized mixture, carefully greased with fine almond oil, into a goblet or basket shape
Press the entire form as thin as possible with a lemon
When completely cooled, carefully turn out and place on a plate nicely covered with a kitchen cloth
Fill the entire opening high with whipped cream, which gives it a very beautiful appearance

title: Pesti almás-lepény (Pest-style Apple Cake)
description: A cake made with almonds, raisins, and apples.
steps: Prepare puff pastry from {{source-0}}, ten dekagrams butter, one whole egg, and milk
Work it well and tear off twenty-five small pieces (cipócskák)
Cover with a warm cloth and let rise for half an hour
Finely chop fourteen dekagrams softened almonds
Remove pits from twenty-one dekagrams raisins and chop roughly
Finely grind fourteen dekagrams sugar and little cinnamon and mix well together
Cut sour, crumbly, peeled apples into very thin slices
Butter a flat plate prepared for this purpose
Stretch out one piece at a time over the plate
Brush each layer over the plate with melted butter and continue until eight layers are stretched out
Line with the chopped apples and half of the filling on top
Then again eight layers of pastry, each brushed with butter individually, then again a row of apples and filling
Finally stretch out the remaining nine pieces
Smooth the pastry hanging over the plate edge with a rolling pin so the layers stay together
Brush the top layer with egg white and pierce the pastry with vanilla a few times so it does not puff up during baking
Put in the oven and bake until nicely light brown
When baked, sprinkle with sugar and serve; can also be served cold

description: Prepared with egg yolks, cream, and butter.
steps: Cream together 7 dekagrams butter
Add 2 whole eggs and 3 egg yolks one after another
Season with salt and add enough flour to bind the dough but keep it soft
Bring 7 deciliters cream to a boil with a little sugar
Drop noodles evenly into the cream with a spoon
When cooked, remove and place in a deep porcelain dish or pot
Beat 4 egg yolks in a small pot
Pour the cream with crushed sugar and vanilla into the egg yolks and whisk well
Pour over the noodles
Place in the oven until the noodles brown and the cream becomes thick
Sprinkle with sugar and serve

description: Prepared with almond, orange, and lemon.

ingredients.sourceText: 28 dekagrams soaked almond, cut in slivers

When hardened, remove and prepare the rest of the wafers the same way

title: Piskóta-pép (Sponge Pudding)
description: A pudding made with lemon or orange, egg yolks, and flour or potato starch.

ingredients.name: fine flour or sifted potato starch
ingredients.sourceText: 70 grams fine flour or sifted potato starch

ingredients.name: sour cherry or currant syrup cooked in sugar
ingredients.sourceText: sour cherry or currant syrup cooked in sugar

steps: Lightly rub the sugar on a lemon or orange, grind finely and sift
Put with two egg yolks in a bowl and beat for three-quarters of an hour
Gently fold in seven dekagrams fine flour or sifted potato starch with the stiffly beaten whites of five eggs
Pour the whipped mixture into a buttered mold and steam for three-quarters of an hour
Do not give too much heat on top so it does not brown, but only steams out
When serving, turn out onto a plate and pour sour cherry or currant syrup cooked in sugar around it
Or prepare a chocolate cream from chocolate cooked in cream, beat it into a mousse, and heap it high in a wide ring so the beautiful yellow pudding rises only in the center

title: Piskóta-torta (Sponge Cake)
description: A cake made with cake, egg yolks, and flour or cornstarch.

ingredients.name: forty-two dekagrams of sugar rubbed on an orange
ingredients.sourceText: forty-two dekagrams of sugar rubbed on an orange

ingredients.name: twenty-one dekagrams of fine flour or the finest ground and sifted cornstarch
ingredients.sourceText: twenty-one dekagrams of fine flour or the finest ground and sifted cornstarch

ingredients.name: three identical cake leaves and hoops
ingredients.sourceText: three identical cake leaves and hoops

ingredients.name: chocolate icing or fresh raspberry icing for coating
ingredients.sourceText: chocolate icing or fresh raspberry icing for coating

ingredients.name: seventeen to twenty-one dekagrams of powdered sugar
ingredients.sourceText: seventeen to twenty-one dekagrams of powdered sugar

ingredients.name: fresh strawberries for the raspberry icing
ingredients.sourceText: fresh strawberries for the raspberry icing

steps: Grind the sugar rubbed on orange and sift it.
Beat it in a basin with twenty-two egg yolks for one hour evenly.
Gently fold in twenty-one dekagrams of fine flour or the finest ground and sifted cornstarch, as well as the stiff foam of twelve egg whites.
Coat three identical cake leaves and hoops with butter.
Divide the batter into three equal parts and bake slowly over gentle heat.
When well baked, turn the cake leaves out onto a sieve, cool completely.
Then coat every layer with different preserves, stack them on top of each other, and cover with either chocolate icing or fresh raspberry icing.
For the raspberry or strawberry icing: the strawberries should be small and beautifully red.
Sift seventeen to twenty-one dekagrams of powdered sugar finely on a sieve.
Press the fruit through clean cloth and stir into the sugar by spoonfuls so the icing is not too thin.
When the icing is foamy, coat the cake smoothly and evenly with a knife and dry it completely in a cool oven.

title: Piskóta-torta tejfelhabbal (Sponge Cake with Whipped Cream)
description: A cake made with cake, sour cream, and fruits.
steps: Prepare sponge cake dough using twenty-eight dekagrams of sugar as described in the previous recipe
Butter a small cake leaf with the ring together
Fill it with a few spoonfuls of dough, at most three knife-widths thick, this leaf should be the topmost and smallest
Spread the remaining dough onto two cake leaves in the same manner

After buttering these, make a ring around the cake leaves from common dough to prevent the sponge cake dough from flowing, apply it to the same thickness as the first, sprinkle with sugar, and bake at gentle heat until light roll-colored
When the dough is baked, cut out six leaves, each one a fish-bone width smaller in diameter, so that the one you filled in the cake leaf is the smallest
Remove the rings from these

Prepare a butter dough from ten dekagrams of sugar and a little vanilla, fill it into a Spanish piping bag, and pipe beautiful Spanish fritters onto the edge of the smallest leaf so that it forms a nice wreath

From the remaining butter dough, pipe small fritters the size of Italian hazelnuts onto white paper, place these on a sheet in a completely cooled oven so they remain beautifully white but harden and become crispy

Put eight deciliters of sour cream into the whipping bowl, place it on ice, and whip with the whisk until the entire mass becomes stiff foam, then add enough finely broken sugar and vanilla so that it is sweet enough, and quickly stir this in with the whisk
Remove the cake slightly earlier from the oven so it cools, fill every leaf with the sour cream foam to a good knife-width thickness so that the foam comes between all six layer-cake leaves
Arrange beautiful whole fruits on the top leaf of the cake, and place the small fritters around the edges of the other six leaves in a circle
Once the cake is completely assembled and filled, place it on a cake leaf, cover the plate with a tablecloth, and quickly serve it on the table

description: A cake made with cream, sugar, and butter.

ingredients.name: 14 dekagrams sugar for sponge cake dough
ingredients.sourceText: 14 dekagrams sugar for sponge cake dough

steps: Prepare sponge cake dough from 14 dekagrams of sugar, spread it smoothly on a well-buttered sheet with a wide knife to the thickness of a knife blade
Dust with sugar and bake at gentle heat until light bread-yellow
Quickly cut long strips with a sharp knife, each as wide as the palm and as long as a span
Place the sheet back in the oven for a few moments, then pull it out without removing it completely, so the dough does not harden and become brittle; therefore the sheet must always be kept warm
Peel off the cut strips one by one with the knife and quickly bend them over a small wooden roller such as those found in toy shops, so that the two ends of the dough come together
Hold it together in your hand until the dough has hardened, then carefully remove it so it does not break
Place it on a sieve in a warm place so it does not soften, and continue until all are bent
Good cream will be prepared separately

title: Piskótatészta-tekercs más módon (Sponge Cake Roll Another Way)
description: A cake made with egg yolks, egg whites, and apples.
steps: Rub twenty-eight dekagrams of sugar on orange, break it, sift it, beat fifteen egg yolks into it, and stir for an hour
Then lightly mix in eighteen dekagrams of flour, finally add the stiff foam of seven egg whites

Since this amount is too much for one roll, prepare it from fourteen dekagrams of sugar as follows: Spread the dough thinly onto a long sheet buttered with butter and bake it at gentle heat until roll-colored
Peel fifteen to twenty medium apples beforehand, remove their cores, cut them roughly into pieces, and cook into marmalade with eighteen dekagrams of broken sugar with frequent stirring

Then finely mix in three spoonfuls of preserved peach syrup, let it cool, coat the roll with it to a knife-width thickness, place it in the oven again until it can be rolled together, and treat it as before

This roll can also be filled with walnuts: cut twenty-one dekagrams of beautiful walnuts finely, as well as the peel of half an orange and half a lemon, stir this with broken cinnamon and twenty-one dekagrams of sugar dissolved in a coffee cup of water, and cook only until the sugar has penetrated everything well and the filling can be spread well
Filled with poppy seed it is also very good and beautiful, as it resembles a yellowish-black ribbon; the poppy seed, once broken, is prepared in the same way as the walnuts

This roll can also be filled with walnuts: cut twenty-one dekagrams of beautiful walnuts finely, as well as the peel of half an orange and half a lemon, stir this with broken cinnamon and twenty-one dekagrams of sugar dissolved in a coffee cup of water, and cook only until the sugar has penetrated everything well and the filling can be spread well
Filled with poppy seed it is also very good and beautiful, as it resembles a yellowish-black ribbon; the poppy seed, once broken, is prepared in the same way as the walnuts

title: Piskótás tészta (Sponge Cake)
description: A cake made with egg yolks, egg whites, and cherries or berries.

ingredients.name: fourteen dekagrams of finely pounded sugar
ingredients.sourceText: fourteen dekagrams of finely pounded sugar

ingredients.name: ten dekagrams of fine dry flour
ingredients.sourceText: ten dekagrams of fine dry flour

steps: Beat fourteen dekagrams of finely pounded sugar well with four egg yolks; when it begins to foam, add the stiff snow of four egg whites and ten dekagrams of fine dry flour
Pour the dough into a buttered pan and bake it slowly
When fully baked, carefully trim the brown crust with a thin knife and cut the whole into slices like rusks
Prepare the cake one day before using, as it cuts better then
Use a mold with an opening in the middle to form a wide, tall crown; butter it well
Line the bottom with whole preserved cherries or rowan berries in sugar syrup, then with quince paste cut into small triangles and softened pistachios arranged neatly

Build strong walls from the cut sponge cake in the entire mold, cut the remaining sponge cake and a little more quince paste into small cubes, mix with small raisins, fill the mold with this and press it down lightly
Half an hour before serving, beat two decilitres of sour cream with five egg yolks, pounded sugar, and vanilla smoothly, pour it on top and set it in a steam bath

Before serving, beat two spoons of preserved apricots with the same amount of pounded sugar and four egg yolks well, pour in five tablespoons of white old wine, put it on a low fire and whip with a whisk until it becomes a thick mass
Turn the cake out onto a plate, fill the opening with French reduced stock, and arrange the remaining sauce around the edge of the cake in a crown shape with a spoon

title: Pogácsa (Hungarian Pastry)
description: A pastry dish made with lard, egg yolks, and sour cream.

ingredients.name: four decilitres of finely chopped lard
ingredients.sourceText: four decilitres of finely chopped lard

ingredients.name: two dekagrams of yeast dissolved in milk
ingredients.sourceText: two dekagrams of yeast dissolved in milk

steps: On a work surface with a rolling pin, work together four decilitres of flour, four decilitres of finely chopped lard, and a little salt.

Add two egg yolks, {{source-4}}, {{source-5}}, and two dekagrams of yeast dissolved in milk, and knead by hand until it becomes smooth dough, roll out very thin, fold together, roll out again, and repeat this three times until at the fourth rolling out a strip the width of a finger remains.
Cut out with a medium-sized doughnut cutter and arrange nicely on a baking sheet, place in a warm spot to rise.

When risen, make light cuts on the surface of the pogácsa with a knife, brush with egg and bake until nicely golden. This very simple dish can be enjoyed cold and warm, and is especially a favorite food of men.

description: Prepared with carp, vinegar, and carrot.
steps: Clean and cut the live carp into large pieces and carefully collect the blood in a bowl with half a cup of strong vinegar
Cut the carrot, onion, parsley root, and celery into fine strips and brown them nicely in a clean pan over flame with continuous stirring
Transfer to a pot, pour over {{source-6}} and {{source-7}}
Add cloves, clove pepper, coarsely ground pepper, and half a lemon peel cut lengthwise, add the fish pieces, pour in a small cup of vinegar and cook the fish well
Place the fish pieces in a deep dish, but continue cooking the head separately
In another pot, brown 2 tablespoons honey or sugar, and when nicely browned, add a handful of coarsely crushed walnuts and the reserved carp blood to the sauce
Bring to a boil several times, then pour over the fish and let it set in a cold place

description: A sauce made with carp, vinegar, and peppercorns.

Remove the bones from five water-soaked anchovies and pound them finely in a mortar with a similar amount of capers and three hard-boiled eggs and press through a sieve.
Mix well with a few spoonfuls of fine table oil and vinegar and pour it over the dish.

title: Porhanyó tészta (Crumbly Pastry)
description: A pastry dish made with egg whites, wine, and sour cream.

ingredients.name: sour cream as needed for moisture
ingredients.sourceText: sour cream as needed for moisture

steps: Into 28 dekagrams lightly salted flour, slice the same amount of butter
Work the butter with the flour using a rolling pin, but do not touch with the hands
Add two egg whites, one full tablespoon of wine, and enough sour cream to make it moist
Mix well with a large knife so everything is combined
The dough should not be stiff
Roll out three times as thin as possible
Fold in four parts on the same side
Use no more flour than absolutely necessary
Then use the dough as desired
Note that soft butter should be used for crumbly pastry

title: Pudding-fagylalt à la Nesselrode (Nesselrode Pudding Ice Cream)
description: A pudding made with cream, chestnuts, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: 7 dekagrams candied lemon peel cut into cubes
ingredients.sourceText: 7 dekagrams candied lemon peel cut into cubes

steps: Cook 0.5 kilogram of peeled chestnuts with a piece of vanilla in milk until soft and press through a sieve
Beat 1.5 liters of cream with 12 egg yolks and 35 dekagrams of sugar over fire until foamy, then press through a sieve
Add 28 dekagrams of raspberry jelly and combine with the chestnut purée
Briefly heat 14 dekagrams of cleaned raisins, 14 dekagrams of currants, and 7 dekagrams of diced candied lemon peel with a little white wine and sugar, then let cool
When the chestnut mixture has frozen solid, mix in 4 deciliters of whipped cream, the raisins and candied lemon peel
Turn the freezing container a few more times
Pour the ice cream into a tall or dome-shaped mold
Close the mold with its lid and place between salt and ice for about 2 hours
Turn the ice cream onto a platter
Serve separately a sauce of whipped cream mixed with sugar and a small glass of maraschino

title: Puhintás torta (Leavened Cake)
description: A cake made with egg yolks, powdered sugar, and yeast.
steps: Beat together {{source-0}} and 8 egg yolks with 4 spoonfuls powdered sugar
Dissolve 3 decagrams yeast in warm milk
Take {{source-5}} and mix with the yeast mixture, appropriate salt, abundant lemon zest, and as much milk as it absorbs to make a good soft dough
Work the dough for a long time, always stirring in one direction to make it fine and soft
When worked, mix in {{source-8}}
Butter and flour a large pan and pour the dough into it, then let it rise in a warm place
When well risen and the pan is full, put it into the oven to bake
When nearly done, beat 8 egg whites until stiff, mix with grated chocolate and powdered sugar, and thickly coat the baked dough
Return to the oven until the foam dries on it
Slice when half cold, as the knife would crush the fine soft dough when hot, and sprinkle with vanilla sugar

title: Pulyka Béllelve (Stuffed Turkey)
description: Prepared with turkey, veal, and goose liver.
steps: Blanch a young but fairly large turkey and split its skin lengthwise down the back.
Using a sharp knife, carefully extract the legs to the thigh and wing, being careful not to damage the skin.
Blanch twenty-eight dekagrams of veal, one goose liver, a small amount of bacon cut to the size of peas, several finely chopped fresh mushrooms and button mushrooms.
Braise with butter and green parsley, add finely minced onion, salt and pepper.
Place everything in a bowl, beat in two whole eggs and egg yolk, mix well with the rest.
Stuff the turkey with this mixture and sew the skin closed at the back.
Cover the turkey with thin bacon slices, wrap well with string and place in a pot that should not be larger than the turkey.
Pour three spoonfuls of good broth over it, two deciliters of white wine and cook slowly.
When the turkey is sufficiently tender, remove it and place where it will not cool.
Skim the fat from the sauce, strain through a sieve and cook until only a small amount remains.
Remove the bacon from the turkey, place on the plate, pour the small amount of sauce underneath and arrange small braised potatoes around the edge.

title: Pulykakarbonád Fricandeauban (Turkey Chops Fricandeau)
description: Prepared with turkey, bacon, and ham.
steps: Blanch a young large turkey in salted water; remove the thighs as large as possible, remove the wings and breast on both sides, keeping the wing as a chop.
Remove the thighbone up to the middle of the joint; the upper part of the thigh should remain nicely exposed, as should the upper part of the wing.
Stud densely with finely chopped bacon, cut the bacon short so it looks nicely curled.
Place a piece of ham and veal knuckle in a pot with a little onion, pour three to four spoonfuls of brown broth over, cover and braise until the chops are well tender.
Remove them, strain the sauce through a sieve, skim the fat and cook until it becomes glaze.

title: Puncs-Fánk (Punch-Filled Cakes)
description: A cake made with cake, lemon juice, and rum.

ingredients.name: sugar rubbed on lemon
ingredients.sourceText: two teaspoons sugar rubbed on lemon

ingredients.name: preserved apricots or raspberries for filling
ingredients.sourceText: preserved apricots or raspberries for filling

steps: Fill a pastry cone with sponge cake batter
Pipe small coin-sized cakes onto white paper
Sprinkle with fine sugar and place on baking sheet
Bake at low heat
When cooled, peel off with knife
Fill half of each cake with preserved apricot or raspberry at the bottom, cover with another cake
For the filling: pour two deciliters water onto twenty-eight dekagrams coarsely ground sugar in a deep brass pan
Place on charcoal fire, stir several times and cook until sugar completely dissolves and thickens slightly
Test by passing a slotted spoon through it and blowing hard on it; if many small bubbles flow through like soap bubbles, the sugar is ready
Remove from heat

Take a new cooking spoon, dip halfway into the sugar and continuously rub against the pan's side, keeping the spoon in the empty pan area, working only what flows from the dipped spoon, doing this quickly and without pause
When sugar begins to develop a white skin, quickly stir it off and continue the previous method until sugar becomes white and thick
Add {{source-4}}, {{source-5}}, and {{source-6}}
Mix well and thoroughly until well combined with the sugar
The filling is good when white and thick like light baby pap
Dip the filled cakes one by one into the filling, turning both sides with two four-pronged forks
Place on white writing paper with the forks and leave until firm
Remove and arrange neatly on a plate

title: Puncs-kocsonya (Punch Jelly)
description: Prepared with lemons, rum, and boiled rice or water or corn or tea or vanilla.

ingredients.name: crushed sugar per one cup lemon juice
ingredients.sourceText: four cups crushed sugar per one cup lemon juice

ingredients.name: one-half cup rum per one cup lemon juice
ingredients.sourceText: one-half cup rum per one cup lemon juice

ingredients.name: boiled rice water or corn tea or Dutch tea (the former is more pleasant due to vanilla flavor)
ingredients.sourceText: four cups boiled rice water or corn tea or Dutch tea (the former is more pleasant due to vanilla flavor)

steps: Squeeze the lemons and strain the juice through clean cloth
Place all the above items in a soup bowl: one cup lemon juice, four cups crushed sugar, one-half cup rum, and four cups boiled rice water or corn tea
Rinse seven deciliters of corn kernels and boil them with eighteen deciliters of water for about an hour or longer
Strain and prepare the punch with this liquid
Stir the items in the bowl frequently until the sugar is completely dissolved
Add five dekagrams of dissolved isinglass mixed with the rest
Strain this jelly through table linen
Optionally color it red with alkanet, then place in a mold and freeze on ice

description: Prepared with lamb, onion, and carrot.

Place sliced red onion and carrot in a pot, put the legs on top

title: Párolt marhahús (Braised Beef with Vegetables)
description: Prepared with beef, bacon, and carrot.

ingredients.name: Six to eight slices of bacon
ingredients.sourceText: Six to eight slices of bacon

steps: Cook the beef as usual
When it begins to become tender, place six to eight bacon slices, one whole sliced carrot, and red onion in a pot
Place the beef on top, cover, and braise slowly
From time to time pour a small amount of good broth over it and turn on all sides so it browns beautifully
Take several young kohlrabi and large carrots and using a special vegetable scoop (the kind used for kohlrabi), cut them into small balls
Melt a piece of butter in the pot with the meat, add a piece of sugar, and when it dissolves, add the carrot and kohlrabi balls
Braise until tender, pouring a small amount of broth frequently over them to prevent browning
Before serving, remove the fat from the sauce, strain through a sieve, and arrange the braised kohlrabi and carrot around the platter as a border
Place the meat in the center, pour the sauce over, and the dish is ready
If serving with potatoes, treat the meat the same way but add a few slices of ham, boil small potatoes, peel them, fry them in butter, and use them as a crown around the meat

title: Párolt Marhahús Burgonyakéreggel (Braised Beef with Potato Crust)
description: Prepared with beef, bacon, and carrot.
steps: Place the cooked meat in a pot lined with bacon, carrot, and red onion slices
Turn frequently so it browns on all sides
Remove the meat and sprinkle with flour
When the flour is browned, dilute with half good broth and half red wine
Simmer until well reduced and strain
Using a special tool, cut small balls from carrot and braise them gently with butter, green parsley, and sugar without browning
Cook three large potatoes, peel, and grate them when cooled
Whip in a piece of butter, mix with finely chopped parsley, potatoes, salt, two whole eggs and two egg yolks
Coat the inner part of the meat evenly with this mixture and bake in the oven until the crust browns nicely
Serve the meat in the center of the dish, place the brown sauce at the bottom, and arrange the braised carrots around the meat like a wreath

title: Párolt tekercsek (Braised Rolls)
description: A bread preparation made with beef, beef marrow, and onion.
steps: Cut pieces from beef broth meat that are as long as a knife is wide but not thicker than a knife spine
Beat them and salt them
Pour boiling salted water over beef marrow, peel off the membrane cleanly, chop it finely, and braise it in butter with green parsley
Add a little chopped red onion, salt, pepper, a handful of breadcrumbs, and some liquid, and bring to a slight boil and cool
Spread this filling on the meat, roll it up, and tie it with thread
Place bacon, red onion, and carrot in a pot, put the rolls in, and braise until their sauce has evaporated and they brown

Remove them, place one to two spoonfuls of flour in the pot, brown it, dilute it with good liquid, add vinegar and lemon zest, cook the sauce well, strain it, place the rolls back in, add two spoonfuls of sour cream, and braise slightly

Arrange the rolls in a line on a serving dish, strain the sauce over them, and border the edge of the dish with crescents made from short pastry, or after cutting off both ends of the rolls, pile them high in the center of the dish, pour the scant sauce underneath, and surround them with a wreath of mushroom or truffle, which has been browned in butter first

title: Ringlót pálinkában (Greengage Plums in Brandy)
description: Prepared with brandy, greengages, and vinegar.
steps: Clean 150 slightly unripe greengages carefully with a cloth and prick them all over with a needle.
Soften them in a mixture of 2 parts fresh water and 1 part white vinegar for three to four hours.
Cook {{source-4}} with {{source-5}} and skim it well.
When the syrup is sufficiently clear, place the greengages in a clean basin, let the syrup cool slightly, and pour it over them.
Leave for 24 hours so the fruit absorbs the sugar well.
Strain the syrup, place the fruit in glass jars, cook the syrup again until it becomes thick, let it cool, and pour it over the fruit.
Pour 1.5 liters of good brandy over this quantity, tie the jars closed, prick the paper with a needle, and store.
When the fruit settles to the bottom of the jar, it is ready to eat.

title: Rizsabroncs (Rice Crown Pudding)
description: A pudding made with rice, ground almonds, and egg yolks.
steps: Grind 10 dekagrams of cleaned rice very finely in a mortar.
Bring 7 deciliters of milk to a boil, add the rice and 7 dekagrams of ground almonds, and stir continuously until a thick paste forms.
Remove from heat and stir in 5 dekagrams fresh butter, then cool.
Add 6 egg yolks one by one and sugar with vanilla to taste, beat until frothy.
Gently fold in the stiffly beaten whites of 4 eggs.
Pour into a buttered ring mold and steam for three-quarters of an hour.
Meanwhile, peel 10 large apricots, cut in half, and remove pits.
Cook 18 dekagrams sugar with 2 deciliters water until it forms heavy drops, add apricots and simmer only a moment so they remain whole.
Remove with a spoon to a plate, sprinkle with powdered sugar, and set aside in a warm place.
Cook the syrup until it becomes a light jelly.
Unmold the pudding onto a plate, fill the ring opening with apricots, coat with jelly, and pour the rest over the fruit.

title: Rizsliszt-pép (Rice Flour Paste)
description: Prepared with rice, ground almonds, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: 7 dekagrams softened and finely ground almonds
ingredients.sourceText: 7 dekagrams softened and finely ground almonds

steps: Grind the washed and dried rice into fine flour
Place in a pot and gradually stir in the cold milk until smooth
Add the softened almonds and place over low heat
Cook with constant stirring into a thick, smooth paste
Remove from heat and while warm, stir in the butter and sugar rubbed on the orange
Cool
Stir in the egg yolks one after another
Fold in the stiffly whipped egg whites

Set in a water bath for three-quarters of an hour and turn out

description: Prepared with rice, milk or broth, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: one piece of cooked calf's head

steps: Cook fourteen dekagrams of well-washed rice in seven decilitres of milk or good broth; when cooked tender, let cool and place in ten dekagrams of butter beaten until frothy, then gradually mix in one whole egg and five egg yolks one after another.

Add the shelled tails and claws of thirty shrimp, as well as two or three portions of soft-cooked goose or turkey forcemeat and one piece of cooked calf's head cut into strips, a little salt, and finally gradually three egg whites beaten stiff.

title: Rizsmeridon más módon (Rice Meridon Another Way)
description: Prepared with rice, egg yolks, and egg whites.

ingredients.name: fifteen to twenty shelled shrimp tails

ingredients.name: six button mushrooms braised in butter
ingredients.sourceText: six button mushrooms braised in butter

steps: Cook fourteen dekagrams of rice in seven decilitres of milk, when cooled, mix with ten dekagrams of butter, one whole egg and five egg yolks, season lightly with salt, and finally gently mix in three egg whites beaten stiff.

Meanwhile, prepare a butter sauce, cut three cooked calf's tongues, fifteen to twenty shelled shrimp tails, six button mushrooms braised in butter, and a few asparagus or artichoke cooked in salted water into large cubes, place in the butter sauce and cook well.
When the sauce is completely cooked, mix two egg yolks with two tablespoons of cold broth and stir into the mixture, bring to a boil once more and let cool.

Arrange the bottom of a well-greased pot neatly with shrimp tails and asparagus heads, place half of the beaten rice into it, then the ragout in the middle and the other half of the rice on top, then place in a water bath where it should remain for three-quarters of an hour.

description: Prepared with lard, lemon, and flour.

ingredients.name: zest of one lemon, finely chopped
ingredients.sourceText: zest of one lemon, finely chopped

steps: Mix seven deciliters of fine flour with salt and twenty-eight dekagrams of lard
Add twenty-one dekagrams of sifted sugar, finely chopped zest of one lemon, a little cinnamon, and crushed clove and pepper
Work all this well together with a rolling pin
Make a hole in the middle of the whole, crack a large egg into it and make fine dough with a wide knife
Roll out to the thickness of the little finger and place on four sheet pans
Create a lattice on top with thin dough sticks
Brush with beaten egg
Bake to a nice light brown
Once removed from the oven, cut into equal rectangular pieces and arrange neatly on a plate

title: Rábaközi perecz (Raba Valley Pretzel)
description: Prepared with egg yolks, sour cream, and cream.
steps: Mix well together 42 decagrams flour with 5 whole eggs and 5 egg yolks, 4 spoonfuls sweet sour cream, and a little salt
Beat all parts of the dough with the axe handle for a good hour
Form small pretzels from it and place them in hot water, 7-8 on a cooking spoon (head down) in the center of the pot

When the water brings the pretzels up, lift the spoon and remove them, quickly drain the water, place the pretzels on a board and press down by hand one by one to correct form, continuing until all are cooked
Turn them in creamy butter, place on a sheet close together, and bake in a moderately hot oven
This amount makes about 80 pretzels, which are good for coffee and tea and have the advantage of keeping for weeks without hardening or losing their flavor

title: Rákleves (Crayfish Soup)
description: A soup made with crayfish, onion, and bay leaves.

ingredients.name: half a liter light table wine
ingredients.sourceText: half a liter light table wine

steps: Wash the crayfish carefully
Put lightly salted water in a casserole and add parsley, sliced red onion, crushed pepper, a little thyme, a few bay leaves, and a pinch of basil
Add half a liter of light table wine
Before the liquid boils, add the crayfish and let cook until completely done, stirring frequently
Remove the tails from the cooked crayfish and extract the meat from them
Grind the cooked torsos with their meat and the claws finely in a mortar
Place this ground mixture in a pot and pour the liquid in which the crayfish were cooked over it
Add 2 liters of fish broth (consommé) and 100-150 grams of white bread crumb
Bring the whole to a boil and cook for a good hour on a careful fire so it does not boil away
After one hour, strain through a fine sieve and set the broth aside

title: Rákmorzsóka (Crayfish Crumb Dish)
description: Prepared with crayfish, flour, and milk.
steps: Whisk flour and cold milk together slowly in a pot
Season with salt
Add 10 dekagrams melted crayfish butter, 8 whole eggs, and 24 finely chopped crayfish tails and mix well
Melt 12 dekagrams crayfish butter in a wide flat pot
Pour the batter into it
Place in a moderately hot oven watching that it does not burn on the bottom
When the batter is golden on top, stir it and braise until it no longer sticks to the roof of the mouth
Serve immediately as it will otherwise dry out
If desired sweet, sprinkle with sugar when braising and serving

title: Rántott baraczk más módon (Fried Apricot Another Way)
description: Prepared with apricots, cream, and sugar.
steps: Peel and halve twelve large ripe apricots
Place in a porcelain bowl
Sprinkle with 14 dekagram finely ground sugar
Pour {{source-2}} over them
Let stand for two hours, shaking several times so the liquid permeates well
Dip in batter, coat in fine breadcrumbs
Fry in hot fat until beautifully golden
Cook the remaining juice into a syrup
Arrange the fried apricots nicely on a plate and pour the syrup over them
Sprinkle with coarsely ground sugar
The same method can be used for orange slices: peel the white skin well from the oranges and divide into six slices

title: Rántott burgonya (Fried Potato)
description: Prepared with veal, broth, and sour cream.

ingredients.name: leftover veal roast or cooked veal
ingredients.sourceText: leftover veal roast or cooked veal

steps: Cut a piece of leftover veal roast or cooked veal into small cubes.
Melt a piece of butter the size of half an egg and add half a spoonful of flour.
Brown it slightly, then mix with one cup of good broth and a spoonful of sour cream seasoned with nutmeg.
Add the chopped meat, stewed mushrooms, and asparagus or artichoke cut into cubes.
Braise everything together until the sauce is reduced.
Cook medium-sized potatoes until soft, peel them, let them cool, and cut off the top and bottom so they stand on the plate.
Hollow them out slightly, beat two or three eggs depending on the number of potatoes, dip the potatoes in the eggs, then in breadcrumbs mixed with an equal amount of flour.
Fry in fat and quickly fill with the prepared filling while still hot.

title: Rántott gesztenye (Fried Chestnuts)
description: Prepared with chestnuts, cream, and egg yolks.
steps: Roast and clean about sixty Italian chestnuts, removing all black spots with a fine knife
Cut them in half
Finely crush one half and mix with 7 dekagram butter
Press through a sieve
In a pot, mix this paste with 37.5 dekagram butter, 14 dekagram ground sugar, and two deciliter cream
Place on gentle heat and stir continuously until the paste becomes slightly firm
Gradually add six egg yolks while stirring
Continue cooking for a few more minutes with constant stirring
Place the paste on a buttered board and cool
When completely cooled, form balls the size of the chestnut halves removed
Flatten the paste, place a chestnut in the center
Fold the other half of the paste over it and continue until all are done
Dip in beaten egg, coat in fine breadcrumbs
Fry in hot fat until beautifully golden
Sprinkle with sugar and vanilla, serve warm to the table

title: Rántott Kelkáposzta (Breaded Kale)
description: Prepared with kale, breadcrumbs, and lard.
steps: Cook the kale heads in salted water until tender and drain
Allow to cool, then cut each head into four equal parts
Beat two eggs well and dip the kale into them
Coat half in breadcrumbs and half in flour, then fry in lard until golden brown
Place small pieces of butter on a serving dish, arrange the breaded kale on top
Add a good portion of sour cream on top and a little butter
Place coals on top and let simmer for half an hour
Prepare the bone marrow patties as follows: after the marrow is cooked, clean it from its membrane
Chop some onion and fresh parsley finely
Melt a little butter in a pan, add the marrow, onion, and parsley
Season with salt and pepper, mix well and brown lightly
Cut two rolls into slices of finger-thickness, shape them round or square
Coat with a knife-thickness layer of marrow and cover with another slice, continuing as needed
Quickly dip these filled slices in milk, beat two or three eggs and dip the patties into them
Sprinkle with fine breadcrumbs and fry until golden brown
Serve the bone marrow patties alongside the breaded kale

title: Rózsa-eczet (Rose Vinegar)
description: Prepared with rose petals or orange and wine.

ingredients.name: fresh rose petals or violet, carnation, orange blossom, bee balm, jasmine leaves
ingredients.sourceText: fresh rose petals or violet, carnation, orange blossom, bee balm, jasmine leaves

steps: Pick fresh rose petals or violet, carnation, orange blossom, bee balm, jasmine or similar flower leaves (depending on which type of vinegar you wish to make)
Clean them of any insects that may be on them
Place them unwashed in a bottle so that it fills three-quarters of the bottle
Pour good wine vinegar into it almost completely full
Tie it with perforated paper and leave it in the sun for 10-14 days to infuse
Then strain it and place it in a clean, well-stoppered bottle
Full violet leaves are worth more than the sucker ones
These vinegars are good not only for salads but for all kinds of chopped dishes and sauces

title: Rózsafánk (Rose Doughnut)
description: Prepared with egg yolks, sour cream, and eggs.
steps: Put two whole eggs, two egg yolks, {{source-2}}, {{source-3}}, and a little salt into a pot and mix well
On a board, prepare a light dough from fine flour and knead it
Roll this out into a thin sheet, but do this carefully so the dough does not tear
Fold in half and cut with a rose-shaped cutter or a medium-sized doughnut cutter if rose-shaped is not available
Stack five such sheets on top of each other, which then form the doughnut
Brush the middle of each sheet with egg white and press together in the middle with your finger
Once the sheets are cut, make five cuts into the edge of each so they look like rose petals
Cover with a cloth so they do not dry out
Fry in fat until a nice golden color, turning several times during frying to achieve an even color
Carefully remove and place on a sieve covered with absorbent paper
Once all are fried, place one whole preserved sour cherry or currant in the middle of each doughnut
Sprinkle with finely crushed sugar and arrange neatly on a plate

title: Salzburgi haluska (Salzburg Dumplings)
description: Prepared with cream, egg yolks, and egg whites.

ingredients.name: One and one-quarter dekagrams powdered sugar
ingredients.sourceText: One and one-quarter dekagrams powdered sugar

ingredients.name: Four additional deciliters cream for cooking
ingredients.sourceText: Four additional deciliters cream for cooking

steps: Put cream and butter in a pot and bring to boil
Mix in flour to make a firm, hot dough
While still warm, mix in six egg yolks and stiffly beaten egg whites
Add salt, powdered sugar and vanilla, mix well
Bring four additional deciliters of cream to boil
Drop hazelnut-sized dumplings into the boiling cream
Remove cooked dumplings and keep warm; repeat until all are cooked

title: Sertéspecsenye barna lével (Pork Chops with Brown Gravy)
description: A sauce made with fat, onion, and parsley root.
steps: In hot fat, cut one head of red onion, one parsley root, carrot, and celery into thin slices
Quickly braise until soft
When softened, brown with a little paprika and ground black pepper
Add the cleaned and salted pork meat
Pour a little water underneath
Braise quickly until tender
If the liquid reduces, pour in hot salted water by the spoonful so the vegetables do not burn, but the gravy must be dark brown
When the meat is tender, remove it and slice it, placing on a hot platter
Pour hot water over the browned vegetables and bring to a boil
Strain the gravy through a sieve, mashing the browned vegetables through it over the sliced meat
This produces a very pleasant sauce, the main thing being that it should not burn but be dark brown

title: Sodralék csiperke-gombával (Veal Rolls with Button Mushrooms)
description: A bread preparation made with veal, mushrooms, and bacon.
steps: Cut thin slices from veal thigh, soften them well, and set aside

title: Sodó-fagylalt (Wine Ice Cream)
description: Prepared with wine, egg yolks, and egg whites.
steps: Finely crush the sugar rubbed on 2 oranges and beat well with 12 egg yolks
Stir in 4 deciliters of good Somlyai wine
Place over charcoal fire and stir until it begins to thicken
Pour into a porcelain dish and cool
Place in the freezing container
When the ice cream has become a solid mass, bury it in ice for more than an hour
Meanwhile, beat 4 egg whites to very stiff peaks so no liquid remains
Mix in 21 dekagrams of finely sifted crushed sugar and a little vanilla gently and quickly with the flat side of a cooking spoon without stirring
Fill this mixture into a pastry bag and pipe beautiful tall Spanish puffs onto paper
Sprinkle finely with sugar using a small tulle bag
Bake in a cooled oven without allowing them to brown
Leave in the oven until they peel off the paper easily and dry

Turn the ice cream onto a platter and arrange the puffs in a spiral shape, using the largest ones for the first coil, then progressively smaller ones, with the smallest at the top so it resembles an artichoke

title: Somot befőzni (Preserved Serviceberries)
description: Prepared with sugar and water.
steps: Boil 500 grams of sugar with two deciliters of water until it throws heavy drops, removing the scum during boiling.
Wash 500 grams of ripe serviceberries, scald with boiling water, and drain well.
Place them in the boiling sugar, do not stir much so they do not separate from the seeds.
After boiling for a quarter hour, remove them with a slotted spoon, and boil the juice until it is thick.
Then remove from the fire, place the serviceberries back in, and handle the same as the previous one when filling.

title: Spanyol széltorta (Spanish Wind Cake)
description: A cake made with egg whites, sugar, and vanilla.
steps: Very finely pound 50 dekagramm of fine sugar with 2 grams of vanilla and sift it.
Beat 11 egg whites in a copper bowl to very stiff peaks, whisking the sugar in rapidly and gently.
The foam must be so stiff that if the bowl is inverted, it remains motionless, achieved by constantly lifting the whisk high during beating, and whipping faster and harder as it becomes stiffer.
Draw four round layers on two sheets of white paper, each slightly smaller in diameter than a pinky finger.
Spread the mixture smoothly onto the traced layers to the thickness of a finger using a knife.
Using a pastry bag, pipe small pastries around the edges of the layers.

For the fourth, smallest, and top layer, pipe four fine ribbons crossing each other, pipe a large tall button in the center, surround it with pea-sized Spanish pastries, and fill the areas not crossed by ribbons with similar nut-sized pastries placed side by side, then pipe similar pastries along the edge.
Dust all layers with finely broken sugar through organdine, and bake in a cooled oven; after one to two hours, the paper can be peeled off with a thin knife.
Fill the layers with preserved fruit, placing the largest at the bottom, then smaller ones, and the smallest on top decorated with whole preserved fruits.
Note that the oven should be neither very hot nor very cold; the best test is if a bare arm can be held in it.
This method applies to Spanish wind paste as well.

title: Spiced Pear (Golden Pear Preserves)
description: A fruit preserve made with pears, lemon juice, and sugar.
steps: Peel the pears and trim the stem so that only half remains on the pear
Brush each pear with lemon juice so they remain beautifully white
Place them in water while you finish peeling all of them
Boil the sugar with a glass of water only until the sugar is completely dissolved
Place the pears in the boiling syrup and turn them with a spoon so they cook evenly
Cook until they can be pierced with a needle, but they should not become very soft
Remove from heat and cool completely
Arrange them nicely in jars and pour the sugar water over them so the pears are completely covered
Tie the jars closed and place them in a water bath, boiling for two minutes
These pears are very beautiful for garnishing compotes

description: Prepared with orange, almond, and cream.

steps: Carefully hollow out 7 oranges and place in clean cold water.
Prepare half the orange aspic and one-third the almond aspic from recipes 812 and 810; these two aspics should hold better with isinglass than before.
Remove orange shells from water and dry well with clean cloth.
Place on a sieve set over broken ice.
Into each shell, pour 1 spoonful of cream aspic; once frozen, pour 1.5 spoonfuls orange aspic over it, then 2 spoonfuls almond aspic, continuing this way to the middle.
Then continue layering until completely filled, ensuring layers are equal in height and always well frozen.
Before serving, divide each orange into 6 parts with a sharp, thin knife and arrange neatly on a plate.

title: Stuffato, vagy Olasz Marhahús (Stuffato, or Italian Beef)
description: Prepared with beef, bacon, and garlic.
steps: Trim excessive fat from {{source-0}}, pound well, and salt
Cut fourteen decagrams of bacon into long pieces and dust lightly with salt and cinnamon
Finely mince garlic, crush it, and mix with bacon
Lard the meat as done for beef à la Modenese
Place the meat in a pot and add four deciliters of white wine and seven deciliters of beef broth
Braise slowly and continuously for four hours, turning frequently
After four hours, add eight medium tomatoes that have been braised and strained, along with a piece of sugar
Continue braising slowly for another hour
Skim off the fat, arrange the meat on a serving dish, garnish with macaroni, and serve the remaining strained sauce in a bowl on the side

title: Stuffed Kohlrabi (Töltött Kalarábi)
description: Prepared with meat, onion, and goose fat.
steps: Cook the young kohlrabi in salted water until half-softened
Cut off a small lid from the top and hollow it out well
Finely chop roasted or braised meat, fresh parsley, and a piece of red onion
Melt a small spoonful of goose fat, brown a tablespoon of flour in it
Add the chopped parsley and red onion, brown them slightly
Add the chopped veal meat and mix well
Pour a little broth over it and cook well
Fill the hollowed-out kohlrabi with this filling
Place it in the prepared butter sauce
Shake it frequently and let it cook for a quarter hour
Arrange beautifully on a plate and serve with breaded chicken or goose liver
