description: Prepared with cabbage, veal, and goose liver.

ingredients.name: 28 dekagrams braised veal, chopped into pieces
ingredients.sourceText: 28 dekagrams braised veal, chopped into pieces

ingredients.name: 1/2 bread roll, soaked in milk and squeezed out
ingredients.sourceText: 1/2 bread roll, soaked in milk and squeezed out

steps: Cook the soft head of cabbage in salted water, cool it and separate into individual leaves

Prepare the filling: chop finely together the braised veal cut into pieces, half a goose liver breaded and fried, a little fresh parsley, grated half a red onion, and half a bread roll soaked in milk and squeezed out
Place in a bowl and season with salt and ground pepper
Add 1-2 tablespoons of good sour cream and egg yolk and mix well
Line a butter-greased mold completely with boiled cabbage leaves
Spread part of the filling smoothly on top
Add cabbage leaves again and continue alternating until the mold is full
Cover the top with cabbage leaves and braise in steam for 45 minutes
Turn out onto a platter

Serve with a sauce prepared as follows: melt a piece of butter the size of half an egg, mix in a spoonful of flour and brown to a dark yellow; dilute with a tablespoon of broth, add 4-5 whole peppercorns, a little nutmeg, and 2 tablespoons of brown broth; cook well, strain through a sieve and cook until thick; pour the thin sauce on the bottom of the platter, place the stuffed cabbage in the center and arrange nice cutlets around it

title: Szalagos Kocsonya (Striped Aspic)
description: Prepared with cream, fish, and currant.

ingredients.name: fourteen dekagrams swollen, finely broken almonds
ingredients.sourceText: fourteen dekagrams swollen, finely broken almonds

ingredients.name: a few bitter almonds among them
ingredients.sourceText: a few bitter almonds among them

steps: Prepare a chocolate aspic from four deciliters of good cream, mixing it with fish glue
Pour into a mold and freeze on ice
Press currants through a cloth, take four deciliters of currant juice
Add the juice of half a lemon to the currant juice
Dissolve eighteen dekagrams sugar in the liquid
Mix in two dekagrams dissolved fish glue
Strain the mixture through a cloth stretched on four chair legs with blotting paper in the middle
When the chocolate aspic is completely frozen, pour the currant mixture on top
Soak fourteen dekagrams almonds, including a few bitter ones, in four deciliters of best cream
Let it stand with the almonds for a few minutes, mixing well
Strain through cloth and add enough sugar to make it sweet enough
Mix in two dekagrams dissolved fish glue
Strain once more and slowly pour over the already frozen currant aspic
Freeze the whole mixture
When unmolding, pay special attention so the form is not left in water too long, lest the stripes melt and the colors mix together

title: Szilvát Eczetbe Befőzni (Plum Preserve in Vinegar)
description: A fruit preserve made with vinegar, plums, and sugar.
steps: Cook {{source-0}} with {{source-1}}, 6 dekagrams cinnamon, and {{source-3}} (break the last two roughly) into a syrup, strain it, and dry the remaining spices on paper.
When the syrup has cooled, place 2.5 kilograms of very ripe beautiful plums, pierced gently with a needle, into a preserve jar, pour the cold syrup over them and leave open for 10 days.

On the 11th day, remove the plums and cook the syrup down to thickness again, then finally add the plums and cook very gently with it, then carefully place in a jar, sprinkling the spices dried during the ten days in layers and pouring the syrup over it.
Seal the following day and keep in a cool place.

sourceSteps: Cook 1.5 liters white vinegar with 1 kilogram 80 dekagrams sugar, 6 dekagrams cinnamon, and 2 grams cloves (break the last two roughly) into a syrup, strain it, and dry the remaining spices on paper.
When the syrup has cooled, place 2.5 kilograms of very ripe beautiful plums, pierced gently with a needle, into a preserve jar, pour the cold syrup over them and leave open for 10 days.

On the 11th day, remove the plums and cook the syrup down to thickness again, then finally add the plums and cook very gently with it, then carefully place in a jar, sprinkling the spices dried during the ten days in layers and pouring the syrup over it.
Seal the following day and keep in a cool place.

title: Szálmi Nyúl- vagy Őzhúsból (Forcemeat of Rabbit or Venison)
description: Prepared with rabbit or venison, rolls, and lard.
steps: After roasting the rabbit or venison, cut out the most beautiful back pieces knife-thin and set aside
Remove remaining meat from bones and fry it
Slice two rolls into wide slices and fry in lard with the minced meat
Pound together in a large mortar until it resembles paste, then place in a pot
Meanwhile, braise the bones with a few bacon slices, carrots, and onions until nicely brown
Sprinkle with {{source-7}} and when brown, cook well with one part white wine and two parts good strong broth
Strain the sauce, add one part to the ground meat, bring to a boil, stir well and pass through a sieve
Add the reserved back slices and boil together for a few minutes
The forcemeat should be pea-thick
Prepare puff pastry and cut out a round piece the size of a plate with a warm knife
Coat the outer edge with egg yolk and place strips of pastry around it
Cut remaining pastry into coin-sized pieces and arrange on the strips so each overlaps the previous one to form a tall crown
Coat everything carefully with egg and bake nicely
When removed from the oven, fill the crown with the forcemeat, pile the slices on top and serve quickly

title: Szénén, illetőleg rostélyon sült (Charcoal-Grilled Meat)
description: Prepared with beef or brisket or kidney, salt, and paprika.

ingredients.name: young beef brisket or kidney loin with skin and flap
ingredients.sourceText: 1 kilogram young beef brisket or kidney loin with skin and flap

steps: Take a large pile of hot charcoal from the store-stove and place it on the stove top, using hardwood charcoal only, not coal
Place a low wire mesh screen on four legs over the charcoal
Cut the meat into pieces the size of a plate and salt them
Arrange the meat in a single layer on the wire mesh above the charcoal
Keep the burning charcoal lively beneath the mesh, as the meat must cook continuously on high heat or it will become spoiled
When one side is nicely browned, flip it with a fork; when both sides are browned, remove it to small white boards
Serve each person on such a board so they may cut it themselves as they prefer, consuming it hot
Pour paprika and salt to the edge of each small board with a teaspoon for each person
This can also be made with lamb brisket, which is much more tender, or with beautiful large beef rib steaks; fatty meat is better

title: Sódar-tekeres (Corned Beef Roll)
description: A bread preparation made with beef, sour cream, and veal or chicken breast.
steps: Make thin round omelet slices suitable for rolling from six eggs.
Chop cooked lean corned beef finely and mix with enough fresh sour cream to make it spreadable.
Spread this mixture knife-thick on the egg slices and roll them up.
Trim both ends to make them uniform.
Line a round or oval mold buttered with the egg rolls standing upright side by side.

Prepare a butter sauce with diced veal roast or chicken breast (removing brown parts), boiled cartifole cut into small pieces (reserving a few smaller rosettes), three small cleaned mushrooms, and 15-20 crayfish tails cut into cubes, braised until the sauce reduces completely.
Beat two egg yolks into the sauce and set aside.
Fill the mold with the forcemeat mixture and steam.
When turning out onto the plate, remove the egg slices from the top and arrange the forcemeat attractively with the cartifole rosettes and crayfish tails.
These rolls can also be made with forcemeat containing marrow.

title: Sódartekeres (Ham Roll)
description: A bread preparation made with ham, egg yolks, and egg whites.
steps: Beat 10 dekagram butter until fluffy and gradually add 5 egg yolks one after another.
Add a little salt, 7 dekagram fine flour, and 3 egg whites stiffly beaten.
Spread the mixture evenly on a buttered pan to the thickness of a knife back and bake over low heat.
Chop some ham finely and grate good Parmesan cheese.
When the dough is light breadcrumb-yellow, remove the pan and sprinkle with ham and 2 spoonfuls of grated Parmesan cheese, then pour 2 spoonfuls of sour cream over it.
Return the pan to the oven for a few moments until it pulls up nicely.
Remove and cut the edge of the dough with a knife, then roll it up, not too tightly.
Spread with sour cream, sprinkle with ham and a little Parmesan cheese, and return to a not-too-hot oven for a few more moments.
Before serving, cut into slices three knife-widths wide with a sharp knife and arrange crosswise on a dish.
These rolls can also be used well for garnishing ragout.

title: Sült nyúl tejfellel (Roasted Rabbit with Sour Cream)
description: Prepared with rabbit, sour cream, and vinegar.
steps: Wash and skin the rabbit thoroughly
Lard it nicely
Pour hot vinegar and water over it
Add sliced carrots, parsley root, sliced onion, celery, bay leaf, ginger, cloves, peppercorns and lemon zest
Let the rabbit sit in this marinade for one or two days, turning it several times during this period

Roast, basting alternately with butter and sour sauce, then with sour cream at intervals
When well roasted, place on a platter and garnish with lemon slices
Strain the liquid in the pan and serve separately in a small dish

title: Tejben főtt hab krémmel (Milk-Poached Meringue with Cream)
description: Prepared with milk, egg whites, and egg yolks.
steps: Beat ten egg whites until stiff peaks form, adding enough sugar and vanilla for sweetness and flavor
Using a spoon, cook dumplings of this meringue in milk and heap them high on a platter
Once all dumplings are cooked, strain the milk
For the cream: beat sixteen egg yolks well with seven deciliters of the lukewarm milk in which the dumplings were cooked
Add enough sugar for sweetness and a little vanilla or grated lemon zest
Bring to a boil while constantly stirring until it thickens slightly
Transfer from one container to another to cool and prevent curdling
Once cooled, pour the cream around the dumplings on the platter

title: Tejfel-pép (Sour Cream Paste)
description: Prepared with cream, flour, and sugar.
steps: Place the flour in a pot and gradually pour in the heavy cream, stirring well to avoid lumps
Add a little sugar and bring to a boil with constant stirring
When thickened, place a large pot lid inverted as a triangle underneath with a strong charcoal fire below
When well heated, butter one side quickly
Spoon some of the paste onto it and bake for one minute
Scrape with a knife and leave only paper-thick layer on the lid
Leave until it browns, then butter again
Cut into pieces and peel off with a knife, shaping into small wafers
Work quickly to prevent burning

Add a little pepper and plenty of grated breadcrumbs between each layer
Place in the oven for quarter of an hour
The potatoes can also be prepared this way with only sour cream, without meat and eggs

title: Tekenösbéka vérmártásban (Turtle in Blood Sauce)
description: A sauce made with turtle, onion, and fish broth or water.
steps: After bleeding the turtle, place in hot salted water and set aside the blood in a cup
Cook the turtle until its shell can be opened (test several times)
Remove the meat from both shells, peel off the outer skin, and cut into desired pieces
Make a light brown sauce with butter and flour
Add a head of red onion studded with cloves
Dilute with fish broth or the water in which the turtle was cooked
Add lemon peel and half a lemon's worth of juice
Add the turtle pieces and cook a bit longer

title: Tekercsek mandolatésztával (Rolls with Almond Paste)
description: A bread preparation made with almonds, lemon or orange zest, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: one and three-quarter dekagrams of fresh butter
ingredients.sourceText: one and three-quarter dekagrams of fresh butter

steps: Prepare butter dough
First, grind ten dekagrams of puffed almonds into fine dough
Crush the same amount of sugar rubbed on lemon or orange, crush it, and grind again with one and three-quarter dekagrams of fresh butter, four egg yolks, and the almonds until it becomes a paste
Roll out the dough to the thickness of a knife blade
Cut finger-length rectangular pieces with a warm knife
Brush the edge with egg white
Then spread almond paste on it with a knife, but not quite to the edge
Fold together, press the two ends slightly with the knife back and fry in fat
The fat should not be very hot so the rolls fry slowly to a nice golden-brown color
Sprinkle with vanilla sugar and neatly arrange on a plate covered with a cloth

title: Tepertős Pogácsa (Crackling Scones)
description: Prepared with sour cream, flour, and milk.

ingredients.name: half kilogram fresh, finely chopped cracklings
ingredients.sourceText: half kilogram fresh, finely chopped cracklings

steps: Rub the finely chopped cracklings together with the flour well between your hands
Knead together with sour cream and a few tablespoons of milk so that the dough is rather firm than soft
Roll out the dough to one and a half finger thickness
Cut out with a scone cutter and place on a baking sheet
Brush with egg and bake until slightly browned
